description: This file configures build settings for a Flutter Android project, including plugin management, repository options, and project modules.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a code block to determine the Flutter SDK path from local properties.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Creates a file object pointing to 'local.properties'.

methods.name: inputStream
methods.description: Provides an InputStream to read data from the 'local.properties' file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads properties from the input stream into a Properties object.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the specified property value, e.g., 'flutter.sdk'.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Throws an error if the SDK path is not set in properties.
